title: 第7章 本大王乃绝世天才第8章 本大王这是上了贼船
content_zh:
纯小白闻言一愣。
这全是你的？
这牛皮吹得也太大了吧？
你当本大王是吓大的？
他撇了撇嘴，只当是这个女人在临走前吓唬自己，给自己上个紧箍咒。
“好，我知道！”纯小白点点头。
再一抬头，发现身边空空如也，那红衣娘们消失无踪。
他左看看右看看，也没找到人影。
“呼——”
纯小白猛地松出一口气。
总算走了！
这个娘们厉害是厉害，就是脑子不太好使，忽悠几句，她还真信！
“吾无处不在，你小子嘴巴放干净点。”
那冰冷的声音毫无征兆地在纯小白耳边响起，吓他一哆嗦，扭头看身后，又抬头望天上，却没有看到她的人影。
纯小白心里一沉，“这娘们不会在我身上装了什么监听器吧？”
他立刻浑身上下摸索起来，什么也没找到。
不过他也听说过，有些厉害的修仙者可以在人身上留下印记，在一定距离内，便可通过印记锁定位置、传音。
只是他现在还没入道，看不到这种印记。
不行！
必须赶紧找个宗门加入，学会修仙功法，想办法把这印记给去了，才能彻底摆脱这个娘们儿！

纯小白抬头看向前方。
广场上黑压压全都是和他年纪相仿的男男女女，他们一个个神色焦急地朝着山顶上那个巨大的平台跑去。
他也赶紧汇入人群，顺手从身旁薅过一个身着华袍、身形干瘦的小年轻，开口问道。
“兄台，你们怎么搞得这么着急？”
那华袍青年听到这话，愣了一下。
随后上下打量了一番纯小白，见他一身的破旧麻布衣，这才开口解释道。
“难道你不知道？这里是十年一度的仙门招收大会？”
“知道啊！”纯小白点了点头，“可为什么要这么着急？”
“因为各大宗门每十年招收的弟子名额都是有限，先到先得！去晚了，就只能等下个十年了！”
说完，那青年一把甩开纯小白的胳膊，赶紧朝着山上跑去。
“先到先得？”
content_en:
Chun Xiaobai was stunned when he heard this.
Is this all yours?
Isn't this boasting too much?
Do you think this king is scared?
He curled his lips, thinking that this woman was scaring him and putting a tight spell on him before leaving.
"Okay, I know!" Chun Xiaobai nodded.
When he looked up again, he found that everything around him was empty, and the lady in red had disappeared without a trace.
He looked left and right, but couldn't find anyone.
"Huh——"
Chun Xiaobai breathed a sigh of relief.
Finally gone!
This girl is really amazing, but she just doesn't have a good brain. She just lied to her a few words, but she really believed her!
"I'm everywhere, please keep your mouth clean."
The cold voice sounded in Chun Xiaobai's ears without any warning, making him shiver. He turned to look behind him and then looked up at the sky, but he didn't see her figure.
Chun Xiaobai's heart sank, "This bitch won't install any monitors on me, right?"
He immediately groped around and found nothing.
However, he has also heard that some powerful immortal cultivators can leave marks on people, and within a certain distance, they can use the marks to locate and transmit sounds.
It's just that he hasn't entered the Tao yet and can't see this mark.
no!
We must quickly find a sect to join, learn the techniques of cultivating immortals, and find a way to remove this mark, so that we can completely get rid of this bitch!
Chun Xiaobai raised his head and looked forward.
The dark square was filled with men and women of similar age to him, and they all ran towards the huge platform on the top of the mountain with anxious expressions.
He quickly joined the crowd, passed a thin young man in a Chinese robe and asked.
"Brother, why are you so anxious?"
The young man in the gorgeous robe was stunned for a moment when he heard this.
Then he looked Chun Xiaobai up and down and saw that he was wearing shabby linen clothes, and then he started to explain.
"Don't you know? This is the Immortal Sect's recruitment conference held every ten years?"
"I know!" Chun Xiaobai nodded, "But why are you so anxious?"
"Because the number of disciples recruited by each major sect every ten years is limited, first come, first served! If you go late, you will have to wait for the next ten years!"
After saying that, the young man threw away Chun Xiaobai's arm and hurriedly ran towards the mountain.
"First come, first served?"
